purpose: Deterministically enumerate the complete evidence lineage admitted and rejected by the continuing-obligation current-state projection so any substantive or FAIL_CLOSED result can be reconstructed without creating authority.

record_schema.ordering_rule: ordered_records must be deterministically enumerable, but order never supplies authenticity, authority, predecessor validity or transition permission.

frontier_derivation.substantive_rule: A substantive final_projected_state requires exactly one valid frontier whose state derives under the projection contract.
frontier_derivation.fail_closed_rule: FAIL_CLOSED must enumerate the exact missing, contradictory, duplicate, stale, unauthorized, broken-lineage or evidence reason(s) that prevented a unique authentic frontier. It is reconstructed with the same fidelity as a substantive state.
frontier_derivation.no_hidden_exclusions: Every input record must appear exactly once in ordered_records with a validation disposition; rejected evidence cannot be silently omitted.

deterministic_reconstruction_rules: bind exact source closure/handoff/engagement/proposal/version and continuing/successor obligation identities
enumerate every lifecycle observation, resolution receipt and cure receipt available to the projection evidence set
retain each record's evidence and authority references even when excluded
apply the projection contract validation and predecessor rules without latest-record or timestamp authority
record each validation disposition and reason code
construct valid lineage and unique-frontier derivation from VALID_INCLUDED records plus proven equivalent duplicate treatment
emit final_projected_state exactly matching the projection result
if any required input or validation relationship cannot be reconstructed, emit FAIL_CLOSED and identify the reconstruction gap

integrity.manifest_identity: Manifest identity/evidence may attest the manifest bytes/version but cannot validate an otherwise invalid source record.
integrity.reproducibility: Same complete evidence set, same schema versions and same validation rules must produce the same record dispositions, frontier derivation and final projected state.
integrity.history_preservation: Manifest does not replace source observations/receipts; it references and classifies them for reconstruction.
integrity.evidence_set_identity: Two reconstructions may claim the same complete input set only through compatible evidence-set commitments. Matching final_projected_state alone is insufficient.

authority_boundaries.rule: A reconstruction manifest is evidence about derivation only. Its existence, signature, hash, storage, publication or validation cannot create or expand commercial, contract, legal, payment, work, runtime, Task Registry or COSV authority.

evidence_set_commitment.rule: Every reconstruction manifest must bind one deterministic commitment over the complete declared evidence set, including excluded records. Commitment equality is evidence-set identity only and cannot validate source authenticity, authority or completeness against external reality.
